description: Live token prices computed from on-chain DEX pools (Uniswap V3, PancakeSwap V3, Orca Whirlpools) on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain and Solana, with pool depth, confidence and 24h change; plus an Aave V3 yield screener (supply/borrow APY and market size per asset). No third-party price feed: every figure is derived from public chain state. Paid ($0.001, x402).

tokens.description: Comma-separated, max 10: symbols (ETH, BTC, SOL, BNB, POL, ARB, OP, USDC, USDT, DAI, LINK, UNI, AAVE) or chain:address (base:0x..., solana:<mint>)

yields_chain.description: Also return Aave V3 supply/borrow APY for every market on this chain
